word_count_method: Whitespace-delimited words in saved p.teaching-prose only, after stripping tags; excludes headings, SVG, tables, captions, questions, answers, revision and references. Visible article excludes SVG artwork and buttons.

dimensions.M: 15 agriculture and architecture; unrelated medical applications not applicable

checks: Official merged and separate CSIR syllabi, mirrored MP SET syllabus and exact Academy node boundaries checked.

Checked canonical evidence on auxin minimum and cytokinin pulse, STM/LAS/RAX, classical apical dominance, sugar timing, BRC1, strigolactone receptor/D53-SMXL and maize tb1, grass intercalary growth and Lockhart mechanics.
Clarified that early bud release is not sustained growth; hormone rescue is not proof of direct action; local auxin minimum differs from leaf-initiation maximum; retained model and species caveats.
Added sources for GA/GID1/DELLA, SMXL, shade, dormancy and xylem wall structure; corrected reference cross-link and clarified nonproteolytic DELLA exception.
Independently recomputed numerical examples and keys.

review_pass_2.type: internal teaching and assessment audit, separate criteria
checks: Progressive narrative from primary shoot anatomy through stem expansion, niche specification, activation, physiological signals, comparative architecture, and causal/quantitative inference.
Compared strong published 5.C.05 (14,222 teaching words, 137 paragraphs); target 13,966 words, 148 paragraphs and zero exact overlap.
All 52 items have keyed options and explanations, including relevant wrong alternatives; balanced keys; 18 traps and 15 recall prompts.
Re-fetched saved HTML, checked unique IDs, anchors, SVG accessibility labels, zoom targets, ARIA references and parsed reader JavaScript.

quality.assessment: Internal editorial judgment, not independent expert peer review.
deductions: Selected authoritative abstracts and reviews rather than exhaustive primary full-text verification.
Some reinforcing conceptual motifs and model simplification.
Hypothetical quantitative and experimental datasets, not raw primary measurements.
Original questions have not been externally calibrated; several Part B distractors are intentionally accessible.
Static rather than interactive browser/device or assistive-technology testing.
